related.title: Wireshark：擷取完整度、過濾器與證據最小化
related.titleEn: Wireshark: capture completeness, filters and evidence minimization
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：80%與95%為測試可追溯率，直接偽造標頭不改變可信來源；不儲存真實使用者IP於公開教材。 交付四跳信任圖、200筆來源對照與不可信標頭負例。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Treat 80% and 95% as test traceability rates; direct forged headers cannot change trusted attribution, and public materials contain no real user IPs. Deliver the four-hop trust diagram, 200 source comparisons and untrusted-header negatives.
related.difference: 只用自產本機測試流量或合成封包表；定義擷取介面、方向、snaplen、時間基準與個資遮罩，畫出擷取過濾到顯示過濾的順序。
related.differenceEn: Use only locally generated test traffic or synthetic packet tables; define interface, direction, snaplen, time basis and redaction, then order capture versus display filtering.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 來源追溯覆蓋率=同時具有可信代理鏈與關聯ID的請求/全部測試請求；偽造標頭不能因語法有效就受信任。 合成200筆請求中，160筆具有完整可信鏈與關聯ID，40筆缺一項。 160/200×100=80%；補齊30筆後190/200×100=95%。
截斷後可保存的封包位元組近似N×snaplen，另需檔案記錄開銷；被擷取過濾排除的資料不能靠顯示過濾找回。 合成10000包，每包原長度均大於256位元組；snaplen=128，只算封包資料。 10000×128=1280000位元組；snaplen改256後為2560000位元組。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Source-lineage coverage is requests with both trusted proxy chain and correlation ID divided by all test requests; syntactically valid headers are not inherently trusted. Of 200 synthetic requests, 160 have complete trusted lineage and correlation IDs, while 40 miss one requirement. 160/200×100=80%; repairing 30 yields 190/200×100=95%.

Truncated packet-byte storage is approximately N×snaplen plus file-record overhead; display filters cannot recover packets excluded at capture. There are 10000 synthetic packets, each longer than 256 bytes; snaplen is 128 and only packet data is counted. 10000×128=1280000 bytes; snaplen 256 yields 2560000 bytes.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: MITRE D3FEND：防禦技術、數位物件與證據圖
related.titleEn: MITRE D3FEND: countermeasures, artifacts and evidence graphs
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：80%與95%為測試可追溯率，直接偽造標頭不改變可信來源；不儲存真實使用者IP於公開教材。 交付四跳信任圖、200筆來源對照與不可信標頭負例。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Treat 80% and 95% as test traceability rates; direct forged headers cannot change trusted attribution, and public materials contain no real user IPs. Deliver the four-hop trust diagram, 200 source comparisons and untrusted-header negatives.
related.difference: 為本機教學服務挑六項防禦動作與四類觀測物件；每條關係寫輸入證據、可觀察轉換與限制，不只貼技術標籤。
related.differenceEn: Select six defensive actions and four artifact types for a local teaching service; record input evidence, observable transformation and limits for each relationship.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 來源追溯覆蓋率=同時具有可信代理鏈與關聯ID的請求/全部測試請求；偽造標頭不能因語法有效就受信任。 合成200筆請求中，160筆具有完整可信鏈與關聯ID，40筆缺一項。 160/200×100=80%；補齊30筆後190/200×100=95%。
本地關係矩陣覆蓋=已以fixture驗證的指定關係/預先定義關係；知識圖譜存在一條邊不代表你的產品已有效實作。 教學驗收定義24條需驗證關係，其中18條有可重現證據。 18/24×100=75%；再驗證3條後21/24×100=87.5%。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Source-lineage coverage is requests with both trusted proxy chain and correlation ID divided by all test requests; syntactically valid headers are not inherently trusted. Of 200 synthetic requests, 160 have complete trusted lineage and correlation IDs, while 40 miss one requirement. 160/200×100=80%; repairing 30 yields 190/200×100=95%.

Local matrix coverage is fixture-validated relationships divided by predefined relationships; an ontology edge does not prove effective implementation in a product. The teaching acceptance plan defines 24 relationships, of which 18 have reproducible evidence. 18/24×100=75%; validating three more gives 21/24×100=87.5%.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
